title: Bugs upon bugs upon bugs
body:
I think the developers need to go back to testing this app because a lot of things either 1. Don’t make sense or 2. Don’t work

- no skip method for the intro. No I don’t want to listen, and yes I can read faster than your audio
- asking for a rating before I even get to see or test the app’s features
- asking you to pay before you even see the features of the app (again, stupid and giving “scam”)
- prices don’t match. Yearly subscription is $49.99 at checkout. Lifetime subscription doesn’t even show the price their charging you on Apple Pay checkout
- unclear UX, all the features are hidden away within the app and not easily accessible.
- lack of exit ques. No i don’t want to take a pic of my food. No I don’t want to create an account. I just want to backtrack

Seriously. Go back to testing because this app is horrible and I want a refund for whatever I was charged.
